rationale: Build on the current 9x512 reverse recurrent-tail best, but change the carry path rather than replaying scalar sweeps. Each repeated tail block now mixes the proven decoder-output anchor with that block's own first-pass tail state through a learned local carry gate, preserving block-specific information while keeping shapes, compile behavior, exact final eval, and quant-aware endgame unchanged. The added control tensor stays tiny, export-friendly, and directly targets the winning recurrent-tail path instead of adding a separate head.
title: Reverse Tail Recurrence With Local Carry Anchors
